results.title: Federal Judge Ends 23-Year Oversight of Oakland Police Department
results.description: A federal judge has officially terminated the 23-year court monitorship of the Oakland Police Department, marking the end of the longest-running police reform case in U.S. history. The oversight began in 2003 following the Oakland Riders scandal, where officers were accused of corruption and brutality. The case closure transfers full authority over police discipline and policy to the local Oakland Police Commission, though officials note that reform efforts continue.

results.title: Supreme Court lets Trump resume deporting migrants to countries not their own
results.description: The court granted the Justice Department’s emergency request to put on hold Boston-based US District Judge Brian Murphy’s ruling that the Department of Homeland Security’s policy to remove migrants to so-called third countries is unlawful.

results.title: Robbie Thorpe Loses Appeal in Genocide Case Against King Charles III
results.description: An Australian court rejects Robbie Thorpe's appeal in his genocide case against King Charles III, but his legal fight may not be over.

results.title: Kabba Day: Monarch rallies indigenes, targets N500m development fund
results.description: Obaro of Kabba, Oba Dele Owoniyi, has called on indigenes at home and in the diaspora to return home for Kabba Day 2026, as the community targets N500 million for critical development projects.
